description: This file contains the implementation of the LivenessTestGrain class, which is an Orleans Grain used for testing liveness. It includes methods for lifecycle management, label setting and retrieval, timer management, and obtaining grain identities.

classes.name: LivenessTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain class implementing ILivenessTestGrain interface, designed for testing grain liveness and identity.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation; initializes unique ID and label, and logs activation.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation and logs deactivation.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the current label of the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a new label for the grain and logs the change.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer that invokes TimerTick every 10 seconds.

methods.name: TimerTick
methods.description: Method called periodically by the timer to perform actions or log activity.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain instance.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique GUID assigned to this grain instance.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Provides a reference to the grain itself as ILivenessTestGrain.
